questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence using reported speech.
He said, 'I have just finished my homework.'
options: He said he has just finished his homework.
He said he had just finished his homework.
He said he was just finishing his homework.
He said he would finish his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had just finished his homework.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the statement?
She said, 'I will call you tomorrow.'
options: She said she will call me tomorrow.
She said she would call me tomorrow.
She said she is calling me tomorrow.
She said she calls me tomorrow.
questions.answer: She said she would call me tomorrow.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the passive voice.
This house ________ by the architect last year.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'was designed' as it fits the context of a house being designed by an architect.)*

Choose the correct sentence with the third conditional.
If I ________ known your address, I would have sent you the book.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'hadn't' as it refers to a past hypothetical condition that did not happen.)*

Which sentence correctly uses a discourse marker to give an example?

I think you should consider this point, for instance, the data shows a clear increase.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'for instance' as it is a common discourse marker used to introduce an example.)*

Select the correct collocation.
He is a very ________ person; he always helps others.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'generous' as it is the most appropriate word to describe someone who helps others.)*

Choose the correct dependent preposition.
We decided to go there ________ the weather being good.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'because' as it is the most direct and common dependent preposition for expressing a reason.)*

Which sentence correctly uses the word in brackets to complete the meaning?

The museum was completely ________ by the fire.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'destroyed' as it is the most appropriate word to describe the state of the museum after a fire.)*

Select the correct form to complete the sentence.
If only we ________ all the problems solved!

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'could' as it is used in third conditional sentences with 'if only' to express regret about past or present situations.)*

Which sentence correctly uses the word in brackets to complete the meaning?

She was too tired to ________ any longer.

*(Note: The correct answer should be 'carry on' as it is the most common collocation with 'too tired' meaning to continue an activity.)*
